he has infinite joy and happiness in himself, which cannot be broken in upon by either the sins or the miseries of his creatures. Not that there is any change in God
for he is of one mind, and who can turn him? But his goodness is his glory
by it he proclaims his name, and magnifies it
and as he is pleased to put himself into the relation of a father to his people, so he is pleased to represent his goodness to them by the compassion of a father to his children
for as he is the Father of lights, so is he the Father of mercies.
